title: MoDL tied denoiser with iteration Mirror coordinate
hypothesis: On a held-out synthetic coil-sensitivity scanner, three per-iteration Givens views over the hidden channels of one MoDL denoiser recover useful iteration-specific priors beyond the native tied denoiser and match or beat a same-size per-iteration scalar-step control, while preserving the explicit MRI forward/adjoint data-consistency operator.

prior_art.paper: MoDL: Model Based Deep Learning Architecture for Inverse Problems
prior_art.official_code_license: not declared in repository root; no code copied
prior_art.implementation_note: Independent PyTorch implementation from paper equations. Official repository uses TensorFlow 1.x and is not runnable in this Python 3.12 CPU environment.

model.cnn: residual 3-layer real/imag CNN, 2->8->8->2 channels, shared across steps for native MoDL

data.type: deterministic synthetic analytic phantoms with four smooth coil sensitivity maps
data.target_scanner: B; coil amplitude/phase shifted; support 8 seeds 107101..107108; development 16 seeds 107201..107216
data.boundary: mechanism-only synthetic reconstruction, not fastMRI or clinical evidence

controls: independent per-step CNNs pretrained on scanner A (frozen on scanner B)
ordinary native MoDL shared CNN and shared lambda, trained tied from initialization
shared CNN plus three independently learned scalar lambda_i steps
shared CNN plus three Givens angles applied to hidden feature-channel pairs
independent per-step CNNs fine-tuned on target support upper control
protocol.mirror_placement: one per-step angle rotates every adjacent pair of the 8 hidden CNN channels after the first convolution; it cannot access mask, k-space, or CG state
protocol.data_consistency: A and A^H use the same measured mask and coil maps in all methods; CG solves (A^H A + lambda_i I)x = A^H y + lambda_i D(x_prev). Only scalar-step control may vary lambda_i; Mirror angles do not alter A, A^H, mask, measured k-space, or lambda.
protocol.fresh_gate: fresh used only if development passes all predeclared quality/control/storage gates
protocol.initialization: Independent and tied pretraining both reset torch.manual_seed(107001) before construction, so their first denoiser begins from identical weights; subsequent cascade CNNs in the independent model are independently initialized.

success_gate: Mirror improves hard-tied dev NMSE by >=10%, is within 5% relative NMSE of independent full fine-tune, beats per-step scalar lambda_i, uses >=20% fewer serialized total bytes than independent fine-tune, and preserves the exact same A/A^H/mask path; fresh must confirm direction in all three worlds before PROMISING.
failure_gate: Mirror is matched/dominated by native tied MoDL or scalar lambda_i at equal/lower bytes, misses quality gate, or changes the measured-data operator.
boundaries: Synthetic small model only; not fastMRI acquisition data or a clinical claim.
One seed and one coil-shift family in this screen.
No patient data or diagnosis task.
failure_gate_result: The 3-angle Givens view has dev NMSE 0.047501 versus tied 0.047493 and scalar per-step lambda 0.047129, costs 6861 B versus 6609 B, and misses independent FT NMSE 0.024894. Fresh remains sealed.
